verdict.rationale: Rippling publishes an official CLI (github.com/Rippling/rippling-cli). Its Flux commands let first- and third-party developers create, manage and deploy Rippling-hosted integrations, and a probe confirms the CLI is documented. A developer llms.txt also exists, which supports AI-native developer use. Missing for 10: detailed command reference or coverage beyond integration development (e.g., HR/payroll data operations), explicit AI/agent-oriented CLI workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
